app_in_progress: The new Nomi is on its way.
plan_note: Each step goes to the crew member who owns it
clarify_keys: 1–{count} to pick · ↵ next · esc skip all
clarify_review_note: Nothing runs yet. You’ll see the plan first.
feedback_sent: Thanks. Feedback sent with this reply only.
feedback_sent_chat: Thanks. Feedback sent with the whole chat.
dislike_include_chat_help: Off by default. Only this reply and your note are sent; amounts and names stay masked.
share_mask_help: Shows Rp ••• and initials. Your records never leave Nomi.
share_anyone: Anyone with the link can view
share_revoke: You can revoke this link any time in Settings › Data
delete_reply_body: {name}'s reply and its cards leave this chat. Your message stays, so you can ask again. Things the crew already did, like a sent email, are not undone.
msg_queued: queued · sends when you're back online
edit_hint: Sends as a new version. The old reply stays in {version}.
edit_hint_new: Sends as a new version. The old reply stays.
voice_transcribed: transcribed from {duration} of audio · edit before sending
move_shared: Members of {workspace} will see this chat. Your memory and money records stay personal.
new_divider_one: NEW · 1 reply while you were away
new_divider: NEW · {count} replies while you were away
connect_safe: Nothing is created or changed without asking
connect_disconnect: Disconnect any time in Settings › Connections
approval_edit_hint: Your edits are sent as written. {name} won't rewrite them.
background_note: You can leave this chat. I'll post the result here and in Inbox.
crew_working_one: 1 crew member working on this chat
supervisor_note: Nothing that left Nomi was undone.
session_body: Your session ended, so this message wasn't sent. It's saved on this device and goes out after you sign in. The crew's running tasks keep going.
preview_building_meta: The preview opens here after the first deploy
bshare_who_help: Public can appear in search. Unlisted only opens with the link.
bshare_together_help: Invite people to prompt {name} with you.
export_sub: Everything {name} built is yours. Included on Free, no fee.
export_env_note: Env var values are not exported. Set them again wherever you deploy.
firstrun_line: Nomi builds real web apps from a description. You get a live link, and the code is yours to export.
firstrun_name_help: Shown on your projects. Change it in Settings › Profile.
code_readonly: Read-only. Ask {name} in the chat to change anything; every change is a commit you can roll back.
term_note: {name} runs the commands. Want something run? Ask in the chat.
role_view_detail: Open the preview and code, no changes
queue_hint: {agent} finishes one change before starting the next, so edits never collide.
invite_body_prompt: You'll prompt {agent} in this project's chat together with {from}. You can ask for changes and see them in the preview; {from} publishes them.
invite_body_build: You'll build with {agent} in this project's chat together with {from}, and you can publish changes.
invite_body_view: You can open the preview and the code of this project. Changes stay with {from}.
invite_foot: Sent to {email} · expires {expires} · not you? ignore this email
bprogress_note: You can close the app. We'll notify you when it's live.
queue_hint_short: One change at a time, so edits never collide.
home_intro: What should we get done? Ask Nomi, or hand it straight to someone on the crew.
workspace_personal_body: Your chats, memory, money and inbox
workspace_create_body: A workspace holds projects you build with other people. Your own chats, memory and inbox stay personal.
workspace_choose_failed: Couldn’t change where projects come from
shortcuts_body: On Windows and Linux, press Ctrl where it says ⌘.
maintenance_body: Your chats and projects are kept. Nomi opens again as soon as the work is done.
auth_greeting: Hi, I’m Nomi. Let’s get you in.
auth_brand_title: A small crew that works for you.
auth_brand_body: Nomi talks with you. Dana keeps your money straight, Kala remembers, Koda builds and ships your apps. You stay in charge of all of it.
auth_feed_kala: moved your dentist reminder to 09:00 Thu
auth_crew_feed: What the crew has been doing
auth_terms: By continuing you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy. Your chats and memory are never used to train models.
auth_unreachable: Nomi can’t be reached right now. Check your connection and try again.
err_email_invalid: That doesn’t look like an email address.
signin_sub: Welcome back. Your chats, memory and projects are where you left them.
signin_hint: After your password, we’ll email a 6-digit code to finish.
signin_new: New to Nomi? Create an account
signin_reset_done: Password changed, and every device was signed out. Sign in with your new password.
signin_wrong: That email and password don’t match. Check both, or reset your password.
signin_too_many_codes: We’ve sent this account too many codes in the last hour. Wait a while, then try again.
signin_email_failed: Your password was right, but the code email didn’t go out. Try again in a minute.
signin_failed: Couldn’t sign you in. Try again.
google_err_cancelled: Google sign-in was cancelled. Try again, or use your email.
google_err_unavailable: Google sign-in isn’t available right now. Use your email instead.
google_err_conflict: That Google account already signs in to a different Nomi account. Sign in with that one, or use your email.
google_err_expired: That Google sign-in took too long. Try again.
google_err_unverified: Your Google email isn’t verified yet. Verify it with Google, then try again.
google_err_invite: That invite can’t be used any more. Ask for a new one.
register_sub: An email, a password and a name for your workspace. Then a code to confirm it’s you.
register_sub_invite: An email and a password, then a code to confirm it’s you. Your account joins the workspace you were invited to.
register_workspace_help: Where your chats and projects live. You can invite people later.
register_invite_help: From your invite: your account joins that workspace.
register_email_taken: There’s already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
register_invite_invalid: This invite has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
register_email_failed: Your account is made, but the code email didn’t go out. Sign in to get a new code.
register_failed: Couldn’t create your account. Try again.
verify_sub: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for {minutes} minutes.
verify_new_note: New to Nomi? After the code you’ll pick a name and meet the crew. Takes about a minute.
verify_wrong: That code isn’t right. {left} tries left.
verify_wrong_last: That code isn’t right. 1 try left.
verify_resent: New code sent. The old one no longer works.
verify_wait: Too soon for a new code. Try again when the timer ends.
verify_too_many_codes: That’s every code we can send for this sign-in. Start over for a fresh one.
verify_expired: This code has expired. Start over to get a new one.
verify_locked: Too many wrong codes, so this one is locked. Start over to get a new one.
verify_failed: Couldn’t check the code. Try again.
verify_email_failed: The new code didn’t go out. Try again in a minute.
forgot_sub: Enter your account’s email. We’ll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot_sent_sub: If there’s an account for {email}, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works for an hour, once.
forgot_failed: Couldn’t send the link. Try again.
reset_sub: At least 8 characters. Every device signed in to your account will be signed out.
reset_expired_sub: Reset links work for an hour, and only once. Ask for a new one.
reset_failed: Couldn’t save the new password. Try again.
firstrun_failed: Couldn’t save your name. Try again.
invite_signed_out_sub: Create an account or sign in, and the invite opens right after.
invite_access_build: You can build it and publish it.
invite_access_prompt: You can ask the crew for changes.
invite_access_view: You can watch it take shape.
invite_expired_sub: Invites last a week. Ask {inviter} for a new one.
invite_used_sub: Each invite works once. Ask {inviter} for a new one if you still need it.
invite_member_sub: Nothing to accept: you’re a member.
invite_other_title: This invite is for another email
invite_other_sub: It was sent to {email}. Sign in with that address to accept it.
invite_missing_sub: The link may be mistyped, or the invite was taken back.
invite_failed: Couldn’t accept the invite. Try again.
invite_load_failed: Couldn’t load this invite. Try again in a minute.
firstrun_name_required: Enter the name you’d like to go by.
verify_incomplete: Enter all six digits of the code.
admin_area_dashboard_desc: The overview, live agents and usage.
admin_area_user_desc: People, their workspaces and who can use the console.
admin_area_plans_desc: The plans people can be on, and each person’s plan.
admin_area_tools_desc: What the crew can use, and its settings.
admin_area_maintenance_desc: Closing Nomi for maintenance, and opening it again.
admin_area_integrations_desc: Publishing on Shipyard: webhooks, organizations, apps.
admin_area_configuration_desc: Server settings: storage, email, sign-in, payments, sandbox.
admin_forbidden_title: No access to the admin console
admin_forbidden_body: Your account has no admin areas. Someone who manages Users & access can give you some; it shows the next time you sign in.
admin_denied_body: Your access doesn’t reach it, or it changed since you signed in. Sign in again to pick up new access.
admin_not_found_body: The address may be old, or what it pointed at was deleted.
admin_overview_intro: How Nomi is doing right now: who is on it, what the crew is using, and the sandboxes projects run in.
admin_stat_tokens_today_note: in the crew’s replies, since midnight UTC
admin_stat_tokens_all_note: in the crew’s replies, since launch
admin_overview_tokens_note: Counted from the crew’s replies. Usage counts every call to a model, so its totals can differ.
admin_event_expired: {agent} ran out of time in chat {chat}
admin_event_tool_failed: {agent} used {tool} in chat {chat}, and it failed
admin_event_finalizing: {agent} is writing the reply in chat {chat}
admin_live_intro: Every agent at work right now, as it happens. Open one to see the steps it took.
admin_live_reconnecting: Reconnecting: what happened meanwhile is reloaded
admin_live_empty_body: No agent is working right now. New ones appear here the moment they start.
admin_live_feed_empty_body: Nothing has happened yet. Steps show here as agents take them.
admin_live_detail_empty: No recent steps for this agent in the chat’s latest 200 events.
admin_usage_intro: Tokens everyone used in a month, per model and per embedding model, and the sandbox minutes projects ran. Months are in UTC.
admin_usage_cached: {cached} of the input came from prompt caches
admin_usage_spend_note: at the models’ prices, in US dollars
admin_usage_own_keys: {tokens} tokens on people’s own keys, not billed
admin_usage_models_note: Grouped by the model and what it called, under the model’s current name.
admin_usage_models_empty: No chat model was used in {month}.
admin_usage_embedding_note: Turning memories into searchable vectors. It doesn’t count toward anyone’s allowance.
admin_usage_estimates_note: Some providers (Gemini) don’t report embedding tokens: those are worked out from the text’s length, about 4 characters a token.
admin_usage_sandbox_note: Minutes each person’s projects ran in the server-side sandbox, most first.
admin_usage_sandbox_empty: No project ran in the sandbox in {month}.
admin_users_intro: Everyone with a Nomi account: their plan, what they used this month on Nomi’s models, their workspaces and any admin role.
admin_users_none_body: Search looks at email addresses. Try part of one.
admin_users_empty_body: People show here once they make an account.
admin_user_profile_desc: How they’re shown in Nomi. A username is letters, digits, dots and underscores.
admin_user_access_desc: What they can see and change in this console, area by area. You can give up to your own level; it applies from their next sign-in.
admin_user_access_platform: A platform admin has every area at manage. That’s set in the database, not here.
admin_user_access_saved: Admin access saved. It applies from their next sign-in.
admin_user_access_invalid: The admin access couldn’t be read. Reload the page and try again.
admin_user_workspaces_desc: The workspaces they belong to, and their role in each.
admin_user_plan_desc: Their plan, and an allowance of their own for a while (a pilot, a refund). Allowances are tokens a month on Nomi’s models.
admin_user_quota_invalid: The allowance is a whole number of tokens.
admin_user_grants_desc: Permissions given in a workspace beyond their role there.
admin_user_revoke_body: They lose it at once, on every device.
admin_plans_intro: What each plan gives a month on Nomi’s models, its price, and who is on it. New people start on the default.
admin_plans_empty_body: Add one to say what people get each month.
admin_plan_details_desc: What people see when they choose a plan. The slug is its id in links and the API: keep it once people are on it.
admin_plan_tokens_helper: On Nomi’s models. Use with someone’s own key isn’t counted.
admin_plan_price_helper: As it’s shown, e.g. Rp 99.000 / month
admin_plan_active_helper: A hidden plan keeps the people already on it.
admin_plan_promo_desc: A label and a price for a while. After its last day it goes on its own.
admin_plan_slug_invalid: The slug uses a-z, 0-9 and - only.
admin_plan_tokens_invalid: Tokens a month is a whole number above zero.
admin_plan_promo_ends_invalid: Write the last day as YYYY-MM-DD.
admin_plan_order_invalid: The order is a whole number.
admin_plan_delete_desc: Only a plan nobody is or was ever on can go. Otherwise, hide it.
admin_notify_intro: Send a note to everyone’s inbox, or to the people on one plan, and see what went out before.
admin_notify_compose_desc: It lands in their inbox and as a notice on their devices. A link opens a page in Nomi.
admin_notify_confirm_body: It can’t be taken back once it’s in their inbox.
admin_notify_required: A title and a message are both needed.
admin_notify_link_invalid: The link is a page in Nomi, starting with /.
admin_notify_empty_body: Notifications you send show here, with how many people read them.
admin_maintenance_intro: Hold everyone on the maintenance page while Nomi is worked on. This console stays open, so it can be turned off from here.
admin_maintenance_switch: Hold everyone on the maintenance page
admin_maintenance_message_helper: What’s happening, in a sentence. Up to {max} characters.
admin_maintenance_saved_on: Maintenance is on. Everyone else sees the maintenance page.
admin_maintenance_saved_off: Maintenance is off. Nomi is open.
admin_maintenance_confirm_title: Hold everyone on the maintenance page?
admin_maintenance_confirm_body: Everyone using Nomi is moved there at once, and stays until it’s turned off here.
admin_maintenance_message_long: The message is at most {max} characters.
admin_maintenance_until_invalid: Write the day as YYYY-MM-DD and the time as HH:MM.
admin_model_label_required: The model needs a name people will see.
admin_model_id_required: Write the model’s id as the provider names it.
admin_model_price_invalid: Prices are dollars per million tokens, zero or more.
admin_provider_headers_invalid: Write each header on its own line as Name: value.
admin_embedding_provider_invalid: Choose openai, gemini, cohere or fake.
admin_models_intro: The chat models Nomi offers everyone, what each costs, and which one chats start on, reads files, and builds projects.
admin_models_empty_body: Connect a provider, then add the models people can choose.
admin_models_roles_desc: New chats start on the default. The files model reads attachments people’s own models can’t open. The coding model builds projects.
admin_model_section_desc: A model on a provider connected for everyone, or one with its own key. Its id is the provider’s own name for it.
admin_model_no_connections: No provider is connected yet. Connect one under Providers, or give this model its own key.
admin_model_key_saved: Saved ({masked}). Leave empty to keep it.
admin_model_base_url_helper: Only for a provider at its own address.
admin_model_found_pick: Pick one to use its id
admin_model_find_failed: The provider’s models couldn’t be listed
admin_model_prices_desc: US dollars per million tokens, as the provider charges. Empty: not shown. Cached input empty: the full input price.
admin_model_media_auto: Work it out from the id
admin_model_delete_desc: People choosing it move to the default. The default itself can’t go.
admin_providers_intro: The AI providers connected for everyone. Models run on them with these keys; nobody sees the keys after they’re saved.
admin_providers_empty_body: Connect one below to offer its models.
admin_provider_disconnect_body: Its key is forgotten. Only a provider no model uses can go.
admin_provider_in_use: Still used by {models}. Move or delete those models first.
admin_provider_connect_desc: From the catalog. A provider at its own address takes the address, and any headers it needs.
admin_embedding_intro: The model memory and search use to read meaning, with its provider and key.
admin_embedding_save_failed: The embedding model couldn’t be saved
admin_embedding_unsaved: No embedding model is saved here yet, so Nomi uses the one its environment sets. Save one to choose it here.
admin_tools_intro: What the crew can use, by who uses it. A tool that’s off isn’t offered to anyone; some can’t be switched off.
admin_key_saved: A key is saved here. Leave empty to keep it.
admin_key_env: From the environment ({env}). A key saved here takes its place.
admin_key_missing: No key: set {env}, or save one here.
admin_search_desc: Where the crew looks things up, and how many results it reads.
admin_search_base_url_helper: Only for SearXNG, which runs at its own address.
admin_read_desc: How much of a web page the crew reads at most.
admin_voice_desc: How the crew sounds when it reads something aloud, from ElevenLabs.
admin_voice_voices_unavailable: The voices couldn’t be listed with the saved key, so write the voice id.
admin_agent_required: Name the agent, say what it’s for, and tell it how to work.
admin_agent_look_invalid: Choose a shape, a colour and a motion.
admin_key_name_required: Name the key after who uses it.
admin_agents_intro: Crew members made here, beside the built-in crew. Nomi hands a question to one when it matches what the agent is for.
admin_agents_empty_body: Make one for a job the built-in crew doesn’t cover.
admin_agent_section_desc: Its name, what it’s for (Nomi reads this to hand it questions), and how it’s told to work.
admin_agent_intent_label: What it’s for, in a few words
admin_agent_intent_description: When Nomi should hand it a question
admin_agent_prompt_helper: Its instructions, as you’d brief a new teammate.
admin_agent_tools_none: The tools couldn’t be listed, so its tools stay as they are.
admin_agent_delegate: Hand work to other crew members
admin_agent_look_desc: How its mascot looks and moves where it speaks.
admin_support_intro: What the help desk answers from: articles, the drafts Koda writes from questions it couldn’t answer, the questions asked, and the keys products ask with.
admin_support_drafts_empty: No drafts waiting. Questions the articles can’t answer turn into drafts here.
admin_support_keys_desc: Each product that asks the help desk has its own key. A key’s secret is shown once, when it’s made.
admin_key_made: Key made. Copy the secret now: it isn’t shown again.
admin_key_revoke_body: The product using it can’t ask the help desk any more.
admin_article_section_desc: The help desk answers from published articles.
admin_article_delete_desc: The help desk stops answering from it.
admin_config_section_invalid: That isn’t a section of the configuration.
admin_cfg_attachments_desc: How big a file, a video and a message’s files can be, how many files a message holds, and how much each person can keep.
admin_cfg_storage_desc: The S3 bucket attachments and avatars are kept in. Test it with what’s typed before saving.
admin_cfg_google_desc: Signing in with Google, and connecting a Google account for the crew’s Google tools.
admin_cfg_github_desc: Connecting GitHub to import and push projects.
admin_cfg_smtp_desc: The server Nomi sends codes, invites and notices through.
admin_cfg_agent_loop_desc: How many turns run at once, and how long a turn or a hand-off may take.
admin_cfg_relay_desc: The images and packages projects’ backends are built from.
admin_cfg_domains_desc: The domain every published app is addressed under. Unset, Shipyard picks one under its own.
admin_cfg_xendit_desc: The keys plans are paid with. Test them after saving.
admin_cfg_sandbox_desc: Projects running on server sandboxes. Anything but on keeps every project in the browser.
admin_config_intro: Every setting Nomi reads, section by section. A value saved here wins over the environment’s; emptied, it goes back to the environment’s.
admin_config_secret_saved: Saved here. Leave empty to keep it.
admin_config_secret_env: From the environment ({env}). A value here takes its place.
admin_config_readonly: Changing the configuration needs manage on Configuration.
today_out_empty: All quiet. Nothing new from the crew since you last looked.
today_reminders_empty: Nothing scheduled today. Ask Kala, or add one yourself.
today_plans_empty: No plans running. Ask Rena to draft one and progress shows up here.
home_placeholder: Ask Nomi, or hand something to the crew…
home_start_offline: You’re offline. Your message is kept here; send it when you’re back.
chat_blank_title: What should the crew pick up?
retry_note: The provider didn’t answer, so I’m trying again on my own: attempt {attempt} of {max}. Typing a new message cancels it.
continued_note: continued after the connection dropped at {elapsed}
send_failed_busy: Nomi is limiting how fast messages go out. Wait a moment, then retry.
banner_offline: You’re offline. New messages wait in the outbox and send when you reconnect.
chat_moved_detail: Filed under the project. It stays private to you.
chat_delete_body: All {count} messages and their cards are removed. Reminders, money records and emails the crew already created or sent stay where they are.
chat_missing_body: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to someone else.
error_body: Nomi couldn’t open this page. Try again in a moment.
chats_intro: Every conversation with the crew, pinned ones first.
chats_empty_body: Ask the crew something and the conversation shows up here.
chat_older_failed: Couldn’t load earlier messages. Try again
projects_lede: Apps Koda builds and ships for you. Each one has its own code, live URL and data, and you can export it any time. For questions and planning, use Chats.
projects_composer_placeholder: Describe an app to build, e.g. a booking page for my barbershop…
projects_rename_hint: ↵ save · esc cancel · URL stays the same
projects_stop_body: Koda finishes the file it’s writing, then stops. The {done} steps done so far stay in the project and nothing is deployed. Resume picks up at step {next}.
projects_deploy_body: Koda builds the {files} files and puts them live. It usually takes about a minute; you can leave this page.
projects_move_members: The {members} members of {workspace} will see it and its {chats} chats. {current} loses access.
projects_move_owner: The URL, deploys and data don’t change. {owner} owns this workspace, so {owner} approves the move.
projects_invite_body: They’ll see every project here and its chats. Your own chats, memory and money stay personal.
projects_first_body: Describe one above and Koda builds it. Each project gets its own code, URL and chats.
projects_load_error_body: Your apps are still live; only this list failed.
projects_github_body: You pick which repos Nomi can see. Remove access any time in Settings › Connections.
projects_github_read: Read the code in repos you pick
projects_github_push: Push Koda’s changes as commits on its own branch
projects_github_never: Never deletes repos, changes repo settings, or sees repos you didn’t pick
projects_repos_note: Koda reads it first and tells you what it found. Nothing is deployed or pushed until you say so.
